item.title: Mad genius attempts hoverboard build, fails, but lands a floating board
item.description: Mad-as-a-hatter British inventor Colin Furze recently set out to create a real-life version of the hoverboard from Back to the Future II. Technically, he failed. But what he built along the way has its own considerable merit: a double-deck skateboard where the top platform floats above the lower…

item.title: Off-grid micro house fits everything you need into just 215 sq ft
item.description: This off-grid cabin-style tiny house is seriously small, with a floorspace of just 20 sq m (215 sq ft). However, despite its compact dimensions, it has been expertly designed to provide everything needed for a short stay.

item.title: Irsay auction recalibrates music memorabilia record books
item.description: The last of Christie’s four auctions of the Jim Irsay Collection has closed, setting 28 new world record prices, most notably the largest memorabilia auction in history (US$94.5 million), the first two guitars to sell for more than $10 million (here and here), the world’s most expensive trumpet,…

item.title: Elon Musk's next moonshot: The $20B "largest chip manufacturing facility ever"
item.description: Elon Musk has previously promised the arrival of fully autonomous Teslas and ultrafast Hyperloop transport – both of which are yet to materialize. For his next trick, the galaxy's richest earthling plans to build an enormous chip manufacturing plant that will positively dwarf every other such…

item.title: All-in-one mini PC aims to replace your dock, screen, and phone charger
item.description: The ViewDock Gen2 is a mini PC that combines Ryzen-powered performance with a built-in display, wireless charging, and a full I/O in a compact vertical design.

item.title: BMW turns April Fool's joke into Nürburgring race car
item.description: It was one of those April Fool’s jokes that PR departments love to make.

item.title: Tiny EDC tool puts a 67-layer Damascus steel knife and bottle opener on your keychain
item.description: EDC hardware brand Orioner says this new folding knife is the smallest piece of kit it's ever made: it's about half the length of your pinky. But there's more to it than its diminutive proportions.

item.title: New supercool alloy could take the heat off helium-3
item.description: The heated race to achieve the extreme cold that quantum technologies demand may have a frontrunner. Chinese scientists have developed an alloy that almost reaches absolute zero, the coldest possible temperature, without using the scarce isotope, helium-3.

item.title: 60-sec cube camper rises & slides into much more than meets the eye
item.description: South African camping trailer specialist Invader is developing the all-new Viator as a roomier, more luxurious alternative to its smaller fold-out trailers. item.title: Yamaha launches the world's first scooter with an airbag
item.description: Safety on a motorcycle is a double-edged sword. On one hand, safety is paramount when you’re riding on two wheels. But on the other hand, how far are you willing to go to safeguard yourself without interfering with the riding experience?

item.title: Off-grid tiny house is well-suited to full-time nomadic lifestyle
item.description: This compact tiny house doubles down on one of the major benefits of small living: freedom. The home runs off-grid and combines an easy-to-tow configuration with an open layout that's arranged on one floor.
